method: One Godot Compatibility draw per fixed simulation tick with VSync off and dummy audio. Scene and actual paper HUD textures use RGBA8 with mipmaps, deduplicated per texture. The transition limit uses active plus preloaded images and the union across adjacent sections. Engine totals separately include render targets, font textures and backend resources.

session_checks.seek_scope: gallery 12s; warm in-process CPU, native binary checkpoints; not a 90s hardware benchmark
